== Decipher replacement-text authority and date ==
The complete replacement wording for [[Fallen Portal (Errata)|Fallen Portal]] appears in Decipher’s 29 January 2002 Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement, PDF page 3. The later Players Committee Appendix A reproduces this wording. Released uses the Decipher documentary bound. The Holotable illustration is a separate source copy; its image date is not this text state’s publication date. The printed Title property, publisher and Errata label follow the primary authority; the GEMP identifier, complete game text, Lore, statistics and images are preserved. [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Primary document]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106202626id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Internet Archive].
